headline.text: Management wording (confident vs cautious cues, -1..+1): prepared +0.80, qa +1.00

tone.method: lexical cue counts on management sentences; indicative of wording, not a measure of business health

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: When I stepped into this role last October, I said we were going to do three things: put our customers at the front and center of every decision, run the company with operational discipline and translate that into accelerating financial performance for our shareholders.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: But in a nutshell, we are accelerating across every key metric.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And consequently, we are raising our mobility and broadband service revenue, free cash flow and adjusted EPS guidance.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: In addition, we added 348,000 broadband net additions, continuing the share-taking momentum we have built over the last several quarters.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: I'm also particularly pleased to say that our net new accounts have also been positive for the past 2 months.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: It's been a long time since we have been able to say that we are now growing both accounts and lines.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: At the same time, we are improving the quality of our gross adds and lowering our cost to acquire and retain our customers.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: When you compound lower churn with healthier acquisition economics, you get exactly the kind of operating leverage you are seeing in our financial results.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: In fact, our financials all accelerated in Q2.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Mobility and broadband service revenue grew by 2.8%, up from 1.6% in Q1.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We see this trend continuing to accelerate in the second half of the year.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And as a result, we are now guiding our Q3 mobility and broadband service revenue to approach 3% year-over-year growth, and our Q4 mobility and broadband service revenue is now anticipated to grow at approximately 4% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: For the full year, we are now guiding revenues to grow 2.5% to 3%, the upper half of our previous 2% to 3% range.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our bottom line also outperformed as our adjusted EPS grew by 6.6% year-over-year to $1.30.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: As a result, we are raising our adjusted EPS guidance to 6% to 7% growth for the year.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And one of the stars of the quarter was our free cash flow of $6.4 billion, up 24% year-over-year, one of the strongest cash flow quarters in our history.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Consequently, we are raising our full year guidance for free cash flow growth from approximately 7% or more growth to 9% to 10% growth.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: This is in sharp contrast to the past 5 years when both our average annual free cash flow and adjusted EPS grew at approximately negative 1% during that time frame.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We also completed $1 billion of share repurchases in the quarter, bringing year-to-date buybacks to $3.5 billion, already ahead of our full year commitment of at least $3 billion.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are now raising our full year buyback target to up to $4.5 billion, reflecting both our accelerating free cash flow and our conviction that Verizon's stock at current levels represents a compelling use of capital.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: In Q2, our consumer promotional cost of acquisition improved by approximately 15% year-over-year, while our promotional cost of retention also improved by approximately 17% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Remember that we are no longer acquiring lines with zero revenue.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And with our new value proposition, we expect our cost of acquisition and retention to continue to improve.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: It will also drive improving revenue growth as we add more net subscribers across postpaid, prepaid and broadband, and begin to benefit from a reduction in our promo amortization headwinds.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: In Q4, we will also lap the year-over-year headwind from our decision to keep our pricing in line with the value we provide.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: As I've said, we will not raise prices without adding corresponding value for our customers.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Following the actions we took after the January event, our network performance metrics have improved sequentially every month as we embed sophisticated AI models that allow us to autonomously fix network issues in minutes as opposed to hours.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our Frontier integration is ahead of plan.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: With 348,000 broadband net adds this quarter, we continue to take share.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: The 10 transformation initiatives we launched are no longer plans on a page.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Each of these will fundamentally improve our ability to serve our customers while driving incremental value for our shareholders.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our new consumer value proposition launched in mid-June, and it is delivering well beyond our expectations across every metric.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: First, we launched the most comprehensive loyalty program in our industry.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: It includes monthly cash back, a redemption catalog that is genuinely differentiated from anything in this industry and the elimination of activation and upgrade fees.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our second innovation is simplicity, a radically transparent and simplified wireless plan, $45 with our best network performance.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And finally, we launched a fully converged nationwide plan called Verizon One, $70 for mobility and broadband together, all taxes and fees included on one bill with integrated servicing across both products.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Lower consumer postpaid churn, healthier net adds and a lower cost of acquisition and retention.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Those numbers tell you that we have already begun to compete differently.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: The economics have been pressure tested.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: The loyalty program is funded within our existing operating envelope and every assumption underpinning Simplicity and Verizon One is grounded in disciplined modeling.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our second announcement is our 50-50 joint venture with BT that combines our respective international wireline assets into a single focused entity.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And most importantly, it allows us to significantly improve our ability to serve our enterprise customers.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our third announcement is also quite consequential because it foreshadows where our revenue growth profile is going from here.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We have other deals that we expect to announce by year-end that, taken together, are expected to be worth multiple billions of dollars in revenue over the next several years.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: The build-out of AI infrastructure across the United States is one of the largest capital cycles of our lifetime, and Verizon is uniquely positioned to participate in it.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are moving quickly to expand our TAM in the rapidly growing AI infrastructure market.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We expect this initiative to noticeably contribute to our revenue growth starting next year and to grow substantially from there.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: In the back half of 2026, our mobility and broadband service revenue growth is expected to accelerate with Q4 forecasted to grow by approximately 4% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: That acceleration is independent of the incremental AI infrastructure revenue that begins to layer into our results starting in 2027.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Said differently, our core business is accelerating and a new revenue growth vector arrives on top of it next year.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: This is a very different revenue growth profile than Verizon has had in a very long time, and it is the foundation of why we believe that we are at the beginning of a multiyear growth story.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: When I gave our initial 2026 outlook back in January, some of you rightly questioned if we could deliver this kind of acceleration in a single year.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are significantly raising the bar, and we are doing it the right way through healthier customer relationships, stronger network performance and disciplined execution.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Tony and I believe that this is what a disciplined focus on customers and shareholders look like.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are innovating and investing in the full end-to-end customer experience.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are investing in our network.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are investing in our broadband footprint and the convergence opportunity.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We're investing in our AI tech stack.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are growing our dividend, and we are paying down our debt.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: The momentum we have in Q2 is driven by our leading indicators, lower churn, quality net adds, increased customer satisfaction, network performance, convergence and OpEx and CapEx efficiency, and they are all pointing in the same positive direction.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We want to earn back your confidence with execution, not with promises.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Our second quarter results reflect another strong quarter of execution, driving further momentum with our operational and financial performance.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The transformation efforts we put in place are gaining traction as we continue to make progress around the customer experience while positioning ourselves to be even more efficient.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: As you heard from Dan, we are increasing our 2026 guidance for mobility and broadband service revenue, adjusted EPS and free cash flow.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We are writing good business, and we continue to focus on growing volumes primarily by reducing churn.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: In mid-June, we launched an industry-first loyalty program for all customers with Verizon Dollars and Verizon Shine.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We also introduced our Simplicity and Verizon One offerings, which streamline our go-to-market approach.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We believe that the launch of Simplicity will be a key long-term driver for margin expansion.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Further, the double-digit growth in app traffic since the launch is a concrete sign of interest in our programs and likely a leading indicator of churn improvement.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The growing benefits we're seeing from churn reduction are allowing us to drive more of our net adds from retention, enabling lower spend on both COA and COR.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We are being disciplined and targeted while also reducing churn with better segmentation.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Our offerings continued their consistent volume growth and positive revenue contributions in the second quarter.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We continue to take share in broadband with 348,000 net additions in the quarter.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We recently launched Verizon One, which is our first unified go-to-market approach for mobility and broadband for both fiber and FWA.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The quality of the business we're writing and our cost efficiency efforts continue to drive strong adjusted EPS growth and industry-leading cash flows.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: As Dan mentioned, we drove an acceleration in our revenue growth rates compared to the prior quarter.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Mobility and broadband service revenue was $23.4 billion, up 2.8% year-over-year and 120 basis points better sequentially.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Wireless service revenue declined 0.7% from the prior year to $20.8 billion.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Total revenue for the second quarter was $34.3 billion, down 0.7% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Sequential improvement in mobility and broadband service revenue was offset by lower equipment revenue, which was down nearly 20% or over $1.2 billion from the prior year as we drove significantly lower upgrade volumes, another demonstration of our more disciplined approach as we structurally evolve our business model.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The inflection in growth we saw in the second quarter, combined with our expectations for the rest of 2026, give us confidence in raising our mobility and broadband service revenue guide.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We now expect to grow mobility and broadband service revenue 2.5% to 3% for the full year.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: In addition, we continue to anticipate wireless service revenue improving in the second half of the year.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Importantly, we are confident that the headwinds from promo amortization have peaked and that these pressures will ease across the second half of the year and into 2027.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We're also making great progress with the Frontier integration and remain on track to deliver over $1 billion in operating cost run rate synergies by 2028.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Second quarter adjusted EBITDA was $13.7 billion, up 7.2% year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Adjusted EBITDA margin was 40.1% and represents the highest that we've ever reported.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: With the strong year-to-date performance and our visibility into the second half, we now expect to grow our full year adjusted EPS by 6% to 7%.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The high quality of our business and our customer relationships continue to generate strong free cash flow and support a healthy balance sheet.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: This was primarily driven by improved adjusted EBITDA performance and continued working capital benefits primarily tied to lower upgrade volumes.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We are executing towards our full year guide of $16 billion to $16.5 billion as we continue to focus on future growth opportunities within mobility and broadband.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: As Dan mentioned, the strength of our year-to-date results and the operational momentum of the business gives us confidence to increase our free cash flow guidance.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We now expect to deliver 9% to 10% free cash flow growth year-over-year for 2026.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The strength of our cash flow allows us to execute on all aspects of our capital allocation framework.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Our first priority continues to be investing in the business.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We're very pleased to have obtained high-quality AWS-3 spectrum that will enhance our network experience in alignment with our commitment to our customers.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: In total, we acquired 82 licenses for approximately $3.2 billion, which is a slight discount to the original auction price from 2015.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The licenses are complementary to our existing spectrum and can be deployed with no capital investment.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: This reflects our prudent approach to spectrum acquisition.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We expect to have this additional spectrum deployed within weeks of the FCC issuing these licenses.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We also continue to deploy fiber at scale to capture growth opportunities, including AI infrastructure builds across the country.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: As Dan said, we expect the amount of revenue associated with these deals to be in the billions over the next several years.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: AI infrastructure represents a large opportunity with a new long-term, high-quality revenue stream that we expect to ramp over the next few years.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: This includes $5.9 billion of dividends and $3.5 billion of share repurchases.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Our cash generation and the strength of our balance sheet provides significant optionality, which gives us the confidence to raise our full year 2026 target for share repurchases to up to $4.5 billion.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Our transformation is taking hold, and we are actively translating operational momentum into sustainable, profitable growth.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: First, our operational momentum is very strong.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Second, disciplined financial execution.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We generated our best ever reported adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA margin.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: With the launch of Simplicity, Verizon One and our loyalty programs, we are successfully capturing new customers and retaining existing ones with robust economics.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We are focused on putting the customer first, growing volumes responsibly and driving meaningful returns for our shareholders.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: This reflects the Board's confidence in our trajectory, our strong results and the momentum of our ongoing transformation under Dan's leadership.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: The entire Verizon team is thrilled by this development, and we look forward to building the new Verizon.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: More details are in the 8-K that we just released.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We have been investing across the entire end-to-end customer journey - in-store experience, digital channels, billing, and customer service.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: You can see this in consumer postpaid churn, which is down 6 basis points and has declined sequentially for two quarters to 84 basis points.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: That improvement has come before our value proposition has fully rolled out, and we expect to see further gains not only in churn but also in cost of acquisition and cost of retention.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are now 40 days into the launch of the new value proposition, and in all my years in the business I have never seen a launch go as smoothly.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are seeing tremendous new account growth.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: As I mentioned, for the past two months we've seen positive new account growth, and I would expect positive new account growth in Q3 as well.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Base migration is roughly one-third of what we had anticipated, and Simplicity has been ARPA accretive.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: On competition, the landscape is shifting away from subsidies and toward the overall end-to-end customer experience - product and service design, servicing, and loyalty.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our loyalty program has received very enthusiastic customer reaction, and many partners are reaching out to join the program with aggressive promotions for our customers.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We're seeing incremental volumes, a very strong start to Q3, positive customer feedback, and meaningful financial impact.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: And based on the strength of the core business, we increased the guide to 2.5% to 3% for mobility and broadband revenue.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: And we said the third quarter would be approaching 3% and Q4 growing around 4%.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: And as we think about looking ahead, we expect wireless service revenue to be about flat for the full year, which implies that the second half would suggest that we see positive revenue growth.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: As we mentioned in the prepared remarks, the promo amortization headwinds have peaked and will ease across the second half of the year and into 2027.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: Prepaid is growing.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: We're growing volumes and now we're growing revenue, which is great to see.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: And as Dan mentioned on Simplicity, we're seeing good green shoots in terms of ARPA accretion and as we look at each segment cohort.

signals.speaker: Anthony Skiadas
signals.sentence: So when you put it together, the actions we've taken are driving durable improvements in our revenue and sets us up well for the strength as we head into 2027.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our cost of acquisition is down 15% and our cost of retention is down 17%.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And with churn beginning to come down, I think we not only will be able to drive our top line consistently and in an accelerating manner, but also begin to see that manifest itself in our bottom line and cash flow as well.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our first focus was obviously to address our mobility and broadband end-to-end customer experience, fix that, launch our new value proposition, put into place our transformation work streams and ensure that we have the right cost structure in place to invest where we needed so that we could drive the results that you're seeing and the returns for our investors.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our long-haul and metro fiber networks, whether dark or lit depending on the customer, are suddenly in tremendous demand for that data center connectivity.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We are announcing a partnership with Google for several of our dark fiber routes for well in excess of $1 billion.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We're clearly an attractive player with differentiated assets that are in high demand.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: The revenues we're talking about are meaningful, have margins equal to or greater than our existing margin structures, and will begin to impact our revenues and margins beginning next year and grow substantially over the next five to ten years.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: As Tony said and I said, these AI Connect revenues are on top of an accelerating core mobility and broadband business.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: All of this is success-based capital that we are putting in, and we see this accelerating business plus our AI Connect infrastructure providing us with a very different revenue future than we've had in a long, long time.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Look, we're very pleased with our broadband net adds.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We continue to take share.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: So we are doing a really great job at cross-sell, and that's accelerating.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: We're growing our homes passed.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: It's interesting with our Verizon One product that we just launched, well over 50% of the people signing on to Verizon One are upgrading their speed levels from that.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: It is very difficult for satellite providers to provide a service that's even close to what we can provide with our broadband services.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: If they try and compete against FWA at 300 meg, that ceiling drops to 5 to 20 homes per square mile versus what we can do is anywhere between 500 and 2,000.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: And it's basically not possible because of physics, not because of execution but because of physics for satellite to effectively compete against the terrestrial network in either mobility or broadband in urban and suburban geographies, which, by the way, is where like 95% to 98% of our revenues are.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Clearly, our anticipation is that the second half accelerates nicely.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: As Tony mentioned, our wireless service revenue will turn positive.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our volumes are growing.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our new accounts are growing.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Our net adds are accelerating.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: Given what we're seeing on the new model around subsidies, which are going down pretty dramatically, promo amortization is going to turn from being a headwind to a tailwind for us next year, we layer on AI Connect revenues would bet we'd continue to see our cost of acquisition and cost of retention go down.

signals.speaker: Daniel Schulman
signals.sentence: So there's a lot of positive momentum that we see.
